defs.def: having a very pleasant taste or smell 美味的；可口的；芬芳的

ex.s: The meat should be fresh with ____43____ touch of sweetness and the soup hot, clear and delicious.
ex.t: 肉应当新鲜，带____43____（一）丝甜味，汤滚烫、清澈而美味。

ex.s: G.The food is so delicious that you don’t need much of it to make you happy.
ex.t: G. 食物如此美味，你不需要吃很多就感到开心。

ex.s: Good Morning Britain’s Susanna Reid is used to grilling guests on the sofa every morning, but she is cooking up a storm in her latest role — showing families how to prepare delicious and nutritious meals on a tight budget.
ex.t: 《早安英国》的苏珊娜·里德习惯于每天早晨在沙发上盘问嘉宾，但在她最新的角色中，她正大显身手——向家庭展示如何在预算内准备美味又营养的餐食。

ex.s: In tonight’s Easter special they come to the aid of a family in need of some delicious inspiration on a budget.
ex.t: 在今晚的复活节特辑中，他们帮助一个需要预算内美味灵感的家庭。

ex.s: His wife Tina cooked us a delicious dinner and we got to know his sons Ryan and Kyle.
ex.t: 他的妻子蒂娜为我们做了一顿美味的晚餐，我们由此认识了她的儿子瑞恩和凯尔。

ex.s: A． 3D Food Printing： Delicious New Technology
ex.t: A． 3D食物打印：美味的新技术

ex.s: It was not only for the delicious food that we seldom got to eat, but for the opportunity to have our whole family gathered together.
ex.t: 我们 seldom 能吃到这些美味食物，不仅为了食物，也为了全家团聚的机会。

ex.s: We toasted each other, we laughed, and the simple, homemade dishes tasted more delicious than anything cooked by a top chef.
ex.t: 我们互相祝酒、欢笑，那些简单的家常菜尝起来比顶级厨师做的任何菜都更美味。

ex.s: It's usually followed by pancakes with maple syrup - delicious!
ex.t: 通常接着是配枫糖浆的煎饼——美味！

ex.s: The majority of us of course don’t tell the truth - we lie and say that the food is “delicious”.
ex.t: 我们大多数人当然不说真话——我们撒谎说食物“美味”。

ex.s: Perhaps the meal you said was “delicious” will be served every time you visit.
ex.t: 也许你说过“美味”的那顿饭，每次你来访时都会被端上。

ex.s: Just quickly tun around and say, "This cake is extremely delicious and you have to tell me all about it.”
ex.t: 快转过身说：“这蛋糕极其美味，你得跟我说说它的全部。”

defs.def: extremely pleasant or enjoyable 令人愉快的；令人开心的；宜人的

ex.s: This delicious tour goes through the city on its way to Treasure Island where we will stop at the famous Winery SF.
ex.t: 这趟美妙的游览穿过城市，前往金银岛，我们将在著名的SF酒庄停留。
